description: Loft conversion with a hip-to-gable roof and a rear dormer. (Retrospective application)
decision_conditions: The proposed roof alteration including the rear dormer window would appear as an incongruous and unacceptably visually harmful feature in rear garden environment harmful to the appearance of the host property, the prevailing character of development and visual amenity in the surrounding area contrary to Policy 26 of the Havering Local Plan, D4 of the London Plan and the Residential Extensions and Alterations Supplementary Planning Document.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: Consideration was given to seeking amendments, but given conflict with adopted planning policy, notification of intended refusal and the reason(s) for it was given to Mr M Akbar (Agent) by e-mail on 27/04/26.
